bagPolicy.summary: Small bags are searched; bags larger than 14 × 14 inches, backpacks, briefcases, luggage and duffle bags are prohibited.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: The venue lists parking near 9009 W Sunset Boulevard, with additional spaces near 8981 and 9022 Sunset; availability is limited.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: Concerto couldn't find a rideshare pickup zone published by The Roxy Theatre. Set your pickup to the venue's address. After the show, use any signed pickup area, or walk a block or two from the main exit before you request a ride so your driver can reach you.

concessions.summary: The venue guide prohibits outside alcohol and other restricted items; check the show details for available food and drinks.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: The Roxy is fully accessible and all entries are accessible. The ADA viewing area is to the left of the VIP section; on show day, ask a manager or supervisor when you enter and they will escort you there.

reEntry.summary: The Roxy does not allow re-entry after a concert guest leaves.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: The Roxy box office is open on show nights only, starting at door time, and will call opens then too. You can also buy tickets for future shows there on show nights.

gates.summary: Most nights doors open between 7 and 8 p.m.; the individual event listing controls and shows generally start 30–60 minutes after doors.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
